notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item used once in tests (pools exactly 4x each count). Training: five topic sets 45401-45405 (huishouding+betalen 44, krediet+risico 48, verzekeringsbegrippen+verzekeringsrecht 36, toezicht 32, rekenen+praktijk+integriteit 40), so the dashboard is 5 sets + 4 tests = 9 steps. passPct 68 = the real pass line (68% of points), 34 of 50 with equal weights. The real exam is 42 questions (63 points) in 120 minutes; Tigertest models 50 one-point questions per test. Categories follow the CDFD eindtermen of module Basis (version 1 April 2026); the per-test split is Tigertest's own (CDFD publishes counts per question type, not per eindterm).
